summary: An Acton dental practice appears to lose new patients to mixed date signals in its footer and no quick message option.

findings.problem: The footer appears to say Copyright 2022 and Site last updated Nov 2026 side by side.
findings.cost: A visitor cannot tell if the content is current, and an old copyright date makes the practice look inactive.
findings.fix: One current date and a refreshed page.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp or text option appears next to the phone number.
findings.cost: Patients who want a quick answer message first, and the practice that replies first gets the booking.
findings.fix: A one tap text button and online booking.
